rights_and_identity.date_limit: 18 August2020 is the uploader-supplied page date, not an independently verified EXIF capture date. No embedded capture date is present and the proposed caption correctly omits an exact date.

visual_review.finding: The central lingam, low rock ceiling, offerings and metal vessels are recognizable and retain useful texture at article and small-preview scales. The prepared image preserves every edge and the original lighting. Bright upper-left rock, deep shadows and a small blurred lower-right obstruction are original limitations; they do not obscure the main subject. No material compression artifact or framing change blocks this documentary use.
visual_review.caption_and_alt: The narrow caption identifies the Shiva lingam inside the cave shrine; alt text describes visible features. Neither infers geological age, dimensions, growth, current access or a present-day condition.
